title: Installment Calendar for Property Charge Advance Repayment Plans: Due Day, Grace, Reminders and Autopay Draft
content:
The installment calendar of Property Charge Advance Repayment fixes the day of the month an installment falls due, when the first one falls due, how many calendar days of grace follow each due day before an unpaid installment counts as missed, when a reminder goes out, and whether installments may be drafted automatically by ACH.

| Arrangement | Due day of the month | First installment | Grace after the due day (calendar days) | Reminder before each due day (calendar days) | Autopay by ACH available | Autopay draft day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | 0 (no installments) | First due day of the month after signing | 0 | 0 | No | 0 (unavailable) |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 1 | First due day of the month after signing | 15 | 10 | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 1 | First due day of the month after signing | 15 | 10 | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 1 | First due day of the month after signing | 15 | 10 | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 1 | First due day of the month after signing | 15 | 10 | Yes | 1 |
| At-Risk Extension | 0 (no installments) | First due day of the month after signing | 0 | 0 | No | 0 (unavailable) |

A value of 0 in the due-day, grace, reminder or draft-day column means the arrangement has no installments to which that term could apply; the Lump-Sum Repayment and the At-Risk Extension carry none.

## Points on the calendar

- **Due day.** In each Repayment Plan arrangement every installment is due on day 1 of the month.
- **First installment.** The first installment falls due on the due day of the month after the agreement is signed.
- **Grace.** An installment not fully paid by the end of the 15 calendar days after its due day counts as missed.
- **Reminder.** A reminder is sent 10 calendar days before each due day.
- **Autopay.** Where autopay is used, installments are drafted by ACH on day 1 of the month.

### Hypothetical calendar

Suppose every borrower signs a Repayment Plan - 24 Months agreement on 18 March. The first installment falls due on 1 April, the month after signing; its reminder goes out 10 calendar days earlier, on 22 March; and its grace runs for the 15 calendar days after 1 April, through 16 April. The dates are illustrative only.
